papers.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
papers.translated_title: Dex-One2Many：从单个人类演示中学习灵巧操作
papers.author: Jusuk Lee
papers.summary: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管从单个人类视频中学习灵巧操作提供了一种有望替代昂贵机器人演示的方案，但近期许多方法主要模仿演示动作。这种严格的运动匹配往往限制了对视频中未出现的初始物体位姿、目标位姿和抓取的泛化能力。另一种方案是通过强化学习（RL）发现策略，这允许广泛的泛化，但如果没有先验指导，它在复杂多阶段任务中难以应对高维探索。为解决这些耦合的泛化与探索挑战，我们提出了 Dex-One2Many，一个从单个人类视频中学习可泛化灵巧操作策略的真实到仿真再到真实的框架。我们的核心洞见是将视频抽象为序列场景图，用以指导强化学习，从而实现高效探索，同时保持广泛的泛化能力。这些图作为生成性约束，用于采样多样化的重置状态，并为每个阶段提供密集奖励。由于图约束的是关系而非精确位姿，这些重置状态覆盖了视频之外的物体位姿和抓取，同时从这些状态初始化每个阶段并配合密集奖励，使探索保持简短且受引导。Dex-One2Many 完全在仿真中训练，并零样本迁移到真实多指手。在五项工具使用和操作任务中，Dex-One2Many 在已见配置上超过基线 6.5%，而其稳健的泛化能力在未见场景中将这一差距扩大到 71%。

papers.title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
papers.translated_title: 评分标准-CEPR：通过奖励验证的自蒸馏实现自进化图像编辑
papers.author: Ritesh Thawkar
papers.summary: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$
papers.translated_summary: 指令引导的图像编辑器已变得非常强大，但进一步提升它们仍然依赖于人工编辑的训练对或外部奖励模型。这类监督获取成本高昂，并且可能奖励看似合理的失败：一个逼真的输出可能并未完成所请求的修改，或改变了本应保留的内容。在这项工作中，我们致力于仅使用预训练图像编辑器自身的生成结果来改进它，而不依赖人工编辑的目标或外部训练时奖励模型。为此，我们提出了一个自演化框架，名为 Rubric-CEPR，它通过一个由评分标准增强的对比编辑-保留奖励（CEPR），利用编辑器自身的内部表示来验证其自身样本。一个规划器（Planner）从未标注图像中提出结构化编辑指令，编辑器（Editor）采样多个候选编辑，一个冻结的评论器（Critic）使用编辑器已暴露的特征，通过分解的评分标准检查对每个候选进行评分，检查包括编辑实现、旧状态的移除以及内容保留。非补偿性门控拒绝不可行的候选，最佳已验证候选通过轻量级适配器训练蒸馏到编辑器中。在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，Rubric-CEPR 将 ImgEdit 从 4.36 提升到 4.60（+5.5%），在物体隔离上获得 +24.9% 的提升，并可迁移到 GEdit-Bench 和 Complex-Edit。相同流程在 ImgEdit 上也将 Step1X-Edit 提升了 +7.8%。我们希望我们的方法能为从自身已验证样本中自我改进的图像编辑器提供一个坚实的基线。我们的代码公开于 $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

papers.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
papers.translated_title: DreamTrue：具有反事实后训练的动作忠实机器人世界模型
papers.author: Junyan Li
papers.summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出了DreamTrue，一个多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，用于动作忠实且物理合理的视频预测。在现有机器人数据集上训练此类模型面临两个障碍：不精确的标定可能损害动作跟随能力，而对失败交互的覆盖有限可能使预测偏向成功结果。为提升跨本体的动作跟随能力，我们将动作轨迹渲染为图像空间条件，并引入离线几何标定以使这些条件与目标视频对齐。为拓宽交互覆盖范围，我们引入了反事实后训练，修改记录的动作轨迹并在更广泛的动作与接触配置下生成未来视频。为在没有配对真实未来视频的情况下对这些预测提供反馈，我们构建了一个人工标注的视频数据集，涵盖机器人、物体和交互缺陷，并用其训练具身视频奖励模型。其评分引导强化学习后训练朝向更物理合理的交互结果。在AgiBot上，DreamTrue达到了最先进的动作跟随性能，同时将人工评估的交互缺陷率从48.12%降低至6.25%。值得注意的是，我们的模型在AgiBot World Challenge 2026世界模型赛道中排名第一。项目页面见https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue。

papers.title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
papers.translated_title: CSF：面向运动生成器的上下文安全过滤
papers.author: Lizhi Yang
papers.summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.
papers.translated_summary: 文本条件运动生成器能够生成可追踪的全身运动，但它们没有场景相关安全性的概念：同一动作可能以物体或人为目标。现有的防护措施要么检查提示词，要么需要标注的运动数据，要么施加几何约束；因此，它们无法直接考虑场景上下文如何改变运动的含义。我们引入了上下文安全过滤（CSF），这是一种无需训练即可使用的过滤器，它将自然语言安全规则建立在生成器产生的安全与不安全参考轨迹之上。对于每条激活规则，安全与不安全参考轨迹定义了一个仿射安全值，由安全参考跟踪 CBF-QP 强制执行。在四种不同架构的预训练生成器上，CSF 在所有显式和场景触发的不安全案例中激活了预期规则，并将危险事件率降低多达 90%，同时保留 88-100% 的良性运动。我们在真实的 Unitree G1 上展示了完整系统，它成功地在各种场景中防止了不安全运动，包括与人和物体的交互。

papers.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
papers.translated_title: 关于AI时间跨度的估计与有效性——对METR图表的统计学审视
papers.author: Drew T. Nguyen
papers.summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.
papers.translated_summary: METR的50%时间视野衡量的是AI以50%概率解决的软件任务的人类完成时间，使AI能力能够以可解释的单位表达。在228个任务和26个AI上，我们使用样条和项目反应理论重新计算时间视野，以放宽任务AI难度线性依赖于人类时间对数的假设。我们拟合的样条可解释为一个将人类时间转换为AI难度的函数；它在2至30分钟的区域几乎平坦，但在其他地方接近线性。因此，尽管乘数同为10倍，从3分钟到30分钟的时间视野跳跃比从30分钟到5小时的跳跃容易得多。总体而言，我们贡献了时间视野点估计，其在交叉验证的适当评分规则套件下表现更好，以及用于评估时间视野构念效度的诊断图。我们建议将时间视野与诊断图一起解读，尤其是在提出新的基于时间视野的基准或现有基准扩展到包含更长任务时。

papers.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
papers.translated_title: 平衡数据饮食：解决机器人控制中大规模强化学习的探索瓶颈
papers.author: Octi Zhang
papers.summary: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.
papers.translated_summary: 通用机器人必须执行从敏捷运动到灵巧操作的各种任务。虽然仿真到现实的强化学习已被证明是实现这一目标的有用工具，但当前的强化学习流程依赖于工程量大、针对特定任务的结构先验，例如塑形奖励和演示。近期工作表明，多样化的模拟器重置结合大规模并行仿真，可以减轻若干操作问题上的大量工程负担。然而，我们发现，将这一范式简单地扩展到更精确或更动态的问题仍然并非易事。虽然模拟器重置有助于探索，但在该分布上均匀采样会将越来越大比例的学习经验浪费在策略已经掌握或尚无法尝试的任务配置上。这使得难以看到为强化学习扩展并行环境所带来的预期收益，因为批次中的大量学习信号在学习过程中被浪费。为缓解这一问题，我们引入了成功引导采样，一种简单的自适应采样器，它将强化学习训练集中在策略能力前沿附近的任务配置上。这样做使大规模仿真强化学习能够充分利用批次中的经验，从而更有效地扩展到大规模并行仿真。在使用多达$2^{20}$（超过一百万）个并行环境的实验中，成功引导采样使强化学习能够解决先前方法无法解决的具有挑战性的多地形四足运动任务和接触丰富的装配任务。最后，我们将学到的操作策略蒸馏为基于RGB的策略，并展示了在真实硬件上对若干具有挑战性的装配任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://sgs-rl.github.io/。

papers.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
papers.translated_title: 从被动遏制到主动保障：来自OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体安全事件的教训
papers.author: Abbas Raftari
papers.summary: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.
papers.translated_summary: 2026年，涉及OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体的网络安全评估触及了其授权测试范围之外的真实系统。路径各不相同。OpenAI的智能体利用了研究基础设施，跨运行进行协调，并侵入了Hugging Face生产环境的部分区域。Anthropic报告了多起案例，其中配置错误的第三方环境将真实系统暴露给了执行模拟网络任务的智能体。在另一项单独报告的评估中，Google的Gemini通过一条非预期的互联网路径访问了三家真实组织；Google表示该模型在三次实例中均停止了操作。综合来看，这些案例表明为何评估不能依赖假定的边界。该边界必须在智能体运行期间得到验证。本比较性工具性案例研究提出了主动式智能体安全保障周期（PASAC）和五层边界保障栈。该框架结合了风险分级任务设计、可执行范围契约、运行前验证、最小能力访问、独立出口管控、凭证限制、跨运行监控、自动停止条件以及基于证据的重新授权。一个先行指标模型、九项设计命题和七项可证伪假设将这些经验转化为可测试的研究计划。由于公开的Gemini记录仅限于归属声明和新闻报道，其详细因果机制仍属暂定。核心结论直截了当：主动式智能体安全需要在完整执行系统中实现持续保障，而非对任何单一沙箱或防护措施的信心。

papers.title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
papers.translated_title: 3万小时的自我中心视频无法教会什么
papers.author: Jiahua Dong
papers.summary: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.
papers.translated_summary: 世界模型为基于物理的模拟器提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但仍远未达到实际部署的程度。我们探究，扩展以自我为中心的人类视频能将其推进到何种程度，为此使用了一个包含30,000小时、涵盖超过1,000种场景类型和14,000名贡献者的数据集。我们没有依赖不透明的下游指标，而是直接在一个具有挑战性的分布外基准上评估智能体和物体交互的保真度。将训练数据增加100倍会改善两者，但改善并不均衡：智能体被很好地建模，而物体保真度仍然远低得多且改善缓慢。我们表明，智能体的提升未必来自数据，而一种精心的视觉条件设计能以一小部分数据使保真度饱和，这使我们能够单独测量物体保真度并发现其饱和点。随后我们引入一种监督方案，将容量从场景外观转向物体动态，改善了物体保真度，尽管仍存在相当大的差距。最后，我们的结论可迁移至下游的人形建模。总体而言，我们的结果表明，扩展以自我为中心的数据使智能体建模接近其极限，却使其对世界的影响远远落后，而弥合这一差距将取决于模型如何被训练，而不仅仅取决于它们看到多少数据。

papers.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
papers.translated_title: OuroWorld：将任意3D世界变为多样且无限循环的3D动态摄影作品
papers.author: You-Zhe Xie
papers.summary: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com
papers.translated_summary: 近期的3D世界模型能够生成照片级真实、可探索的场景，但这些场景在时间上是冻结的。OuroWorld是一个无需掩码的框架，可将任何静态3D高斯泼溅场景转化为3D动态摄影图：一种具有生动、多样运动且能从任意视角无缝循环的动态场景。一个视觉语言模型推断合理的动态并引导视频模型合成参考视频，我们将其提升并补全为多视角视频。为了从这种不完美的监督中学习，我们提出了不一致性鲁棒周期性4DGS：一个傅里叶级数变形场通过构造保证循环性，而一个锚定在参考视图的接地漂移场吸收跨视图不一致性。与先前仅限于类流体运动的欧拉方法不同，我们捕捉一般变形、物体运动和光照变化。我们引入了一种无需真值的评估，涵盖生动性、自然性、循环接缝连贯性和场景质量。在39个重建和生成的场景上，OuroWorld优于所有基线，并在70.8%-99.0%的用户研究比较中获胜。项目页面：https://ouroworld.userwei.com

papers.title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
papers.translated_title: WorldGuide：面向程序性任务执行的目标导向视频世界模型
papers.author: Ankan Deria
papers.summary: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
papers.translated_summary: 视频生成器和基于视频的世界模型能够合成看似合理的视觉轨迹，但长时程程序性任务要求生成过程能够适应实际产生的结果。模型必须根据其生成的状态确定下一步动作，执行该动作，并识别任务何时完成。开环生成无法适应执行结果，而现有的闭环系统通常依赖预训练执行器或间接验证。这在决定动作与成功实现动作之间留下了差距。我们将程序性视频生成形式化为视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行，并提出了 WorldGuide。仅给定初始图像和任务目标，WorldGuide 预测一个原子动作，生成其对应的视频片段，并利用生成结果选择下一个动作或终止。规划器和执行器在同一逐步程序性演示上训练：规划器学习根据视觉进展预测下一个原子动作或任务完成，而执行器则被直接训练以实现预测的动作。分层视觉记忆在有界历史 token 成本下维持长时程执行中的状态。由于缺乏用于联合规划器-执行器训练的逐步动作-视频监督，我们引入了 WorldGuide Bench：约 59K 个步骤标注视频，涵盖 245 个任务和 27 个程序性类别。WorldGuide 在 WorldGuide-Bench 上达到 33.33% 的任务成功率，而近期强视频模型 MiniMax-H3 为 29.90%，尽管 MiniMax-H3 接收了参考动作计划；在 VideoCraft-Bench 上达到 47.69%，而在仅目标条件下 MiniMax-H3 为 32.73%。这些结果证明了将规划与学习到的执行耦合对于目标导向程序性视频生成的重要性。

papers.title: Skeletal muscle enhancer programming of intrinsic cardiorespiratory fitness
papers.translated_title: 骨骼肌增强子编程决定内在心肺适能
papers.author: Weitzel, A. M.
papers.summary: Cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) is a heritable trait associated with improved metabolic health and longevity. Integrating 546 transcriptomic and epigenomic profiles from skeletal muscle of 128 genetically heterogeneous rats selectively bred for high and low running capacity (HCR and LCR), a model that mirrors CRF-associated traits in humans, we identify a distributed enhancer architecture underlying their divergent transcriptomes. Line-divergent alleles were concentrated in distal enhancers: those more active in HCR were enriched for ETS-family transcription factor motifs and positively linked to hundreds of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and angiogenesis genes, whereas those more active in LCR were enriched for Mef2 motifs and negatively linked to these genes. In 426 genotype, gene expression, and chromatin accessibility profiles from an independent HCRxLCR F2 population (n=147), we validated thousands of these genetic effects. Thus, heritable CRF reflects many enhancers cumulatively tuning energy metabolism and oxygen delivery, providing a molecular basis for variation in CRF.
papers.translated_summary: 心肺适能（CRF）是一种可遗传的性状，与改善代谢健康和延长寿命相关。我们整合了128只遗传异质性大鼠骨骼肌的546个转录组和表观基因组图谱，这些大鼠经过选择性繁育以获得高和低奔跑能力（HCR和LCR），该模型反映了人类中与CRF相关的性状，从而识别出支撑其差异转录组的分布式增强子架构。品系差异等位基因集中于远端增强子：在HCR中更活跃的增强子富集ETS家族转录因子基序，并与数百个线粒体氧化代谢和血管生成基因正相关；而在LCR中更活跃的增强子富集Mef2基序，并与这些基因负相关。在一个独立的HCRxLCR F2群体（n=147）的426个基因型、基因表达和染色质可及性图谱中，我们验证了数千个此类遗传效应。因此，可遗传的CRF反映了众多增强子累积性地调控能量代谢和氧气输送，为CRF的变异提供了分子基础。

papers.title: Design of Orthogonal Far-Red, Orange and Green Fluorophore-binding Proteins for Multiplex Imaging
papers.translated_title: 用于多重成像的正交远红、橙色和绿色荧光团结合蛋白的设计
papers.author: Tran, L.
papers.summary: Fluorescent proteins have transformed biological imaging, yet their limited photostability and brightness restrict their applications. We used deep learning-based de novo protein design methods to design binders to three bright, stable and cell-permeable dyes spanning the imaging spectrum: JF657 (far red), JF596 (orange-red) and JF494 (green). We obtain highly specific dye-binding proteins with low nanomolar affinities for the intended target; a crystal structure of one binder confirms close resemblance to the design model. Simultaneous labeling of mammalian cells expressing three dye-specific binders at different subcellular compartments demonstrates the utility in multiplex imaging. We further expand the functionality of the binder by incorporating an active site that carries out nucleophilic aromatic substitution to form a covalent linkage with the dye, and develop split versions which reconstitute fluorescence at subcellular locations where both halves are present towards monitoring in-cell protein interactions and chemically induced dimerization. Our designed high affinity and specificity dye binders open up new opportunities for multiplexed biological imaging.
papers.translated_summary: 荧光蛋白已经改变了生物成像，但其有限的光稳定性和亮度限制了其应用。我们使用基于深度学习的从头蛋白质设计方法来设计针对三种明亮、稳定且可透过细胞的染料的结合蛋白，这三种染料覆盖了成像光谱：JF657（远红）、JF596（橙红）和JF494（绿色）。我们获得了对目标具有低纳摩尔亲和力的高度特异性染料结合蛋白；其中一个结合蛋白的晶体结构证实其与设计模型高度相似。在不同亚细胞区室中表达三种染料特异性结合蛋白的哺乳动物细胞的同时标记，展示了多重成像中的实用性。我们通过引入一个活性位点进一步扩展了结合蛋白的功能，该位点进行亲核芳香取代以与染料形成共价连接，并开发了分裂版本，在两部分均存在的亚细胞位置重建荧光，用于监测细胞内蛋白质相互作用和化学诱导二聚化。我们设计的高亲和力和高特异性染料结合蛋白为多重生物成像开辟了新机会。

papers.title: Dysfunctional effector programming in Foxp3-ΔE2 Tregs promotes enhanced CD8+ T cell responses
papers.translated_title: Foxp3-ΔE2 Tregs中效应功能的编程障碍促进CD8+ T细胞应答增强
papers.author: Weinstein, K. N.
papers.summary: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) prevent autoimmunity through suppressive functions largely programmed by the transcription factor FOXP3. Humans express two major alternatively spliced isoforms of FOXP3: a full-length version containing all coding exons (FOXP3-FL) and a version lacking Exon 2 (FOXP3-{Delta}E2). Sole FOXP3-{Delta}E2 expression causes lethal IPEX syndrome, indicating that FOXP3 Exon 2 is essential for full Treg function. Here, we used Foxp3-{Delta}E2 mice to determine how Foxp3 Exon 2 impacts the functional differentiation of Tregs at homeostasis and during inflammation. Analysis of central and effector Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg populations revealed dysfunctional effector Treg programming, including reduced expression of IL-2 receptor subunits, CTLA-4, and tissue-homing chemokine receptors. During influenza infection, reduced IL-2 regulation by Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Tregs and decreased Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg localization to the T cell zone during priming contributed to enhanced acute and memory CD8+ T cell responses. Thus, dysfunctional effector Treg programming by the Foxp3-{Delta}E2 isoform impairs suppressive function, resulting in failure to restrain CD8+ T cells and aberrant immune responses.
papers.translated_summary: 调节性T细胞（Tregs）通过主要由转录因子FOXP3编程的抑制功能防止自身免疫。人类表达两种主要的FOXP3选择性剪接异构体：包含所有编码外显子的全长版本（FOXP3-FL）和缺失外显子2的版本（FOXP3-{Delta}E2）。仅表达FOXP3-{Delta}E2会导致致死性IPEX综合征，表明FOXP3外显子2对完整的Treg功能至关重要。在此，我们使用Foxp3-{Delta}E2小鼠来确定Foxp3外显子2如何在稳态和炎症期间影响Treg的功能分化。对中枢和效应Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg群体的分析揭示了效应Treg编程功能障碍，包括IL-2受体亚基、CTLA-4和组织归巢趋化因子受体表达减少。在流感感染期间，Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg对IL-2的调节减少以及启动期间Foxp3-{Delta}E2 Treg向T细胞区定位减少，促成了增强的急性和记忆CD8+ T细胞应答。因此，Foxp3-{Delta}E2异构体导致的效应Treg编程功能障碍损害了抑制功能，导致无法约束CD8+ T细胞和异常免疫应答。

papers.title: Combined High Fat and Viral Insults in Pregnancy Disrupt Specific Placental Nutrient Transporter Systems in Mice
papers.translated_title: 孕期高脂与病毒感染双重打击破坏小鼠胎盘特定营养转运系统
papers.author: Ferraz, T.
papers.summary: The placenta adapts to support nutrient transport to meet the demands of the growing fetus. Maternal obesity and viral infection are associated with adverse fetoplacental development. How co-exposure affects placental morphology and nutrient transport across gestation remains unclear. We hypothesise that co-exposure would have a greater impact on placental morphology and nutrient transporter expression than either of the exposures alone. C57BL/6J mice were fed a control (CON) or high-fat (HF) diet before and throughout pregnancy and exposed to poly(I:C) or vehicle at gestational days (GD) 12.5, 15.5, or 18.5. Placental morphology, folate and fatty acid transporter mRNA expression and localisation were evaluated by haematoxylin and eosin staining, immunohistochemistry (reported as % immunoreactivity (ir)-area stained), and qPCR, respectively. At GD12.5, HF diet associated with reduced junctional zone (JZ) area and increased maternal blood space, followed by reduced fetal blood space at GD15.5 and increased JZ and labyrinth zone (LZ) area size by GD18.5. HF diet and viral infection independently associated with increased placental Fat/Cd36 mRNA expression at GD12.5. However, HF diet and infection associated with increased ir-FR- while HF diet alone decreased ir-PCFT at GD12.5. By GD15.5, HF diet associated with reduced placental ir-FR- but increased ir-PCFT. At GD18.5, infection associated with reduced Rfc1 mRNA expression. HF diet and infection associated with greater prevalence of SGA and LGA fetuses, particularly at GD18.5. Obesity and infection independently and jointly disrupted placental morphology and nutrient transporter expression in a zone- and gestational age-specific manner, with consequences for fetal growth across gestation.
papers.translated_summary: 胎盘会适应以支持营养转运，从而满足生长中胎儿的需要。母体肥胖和病毒感染与不良的胎儿-胎盘发育相关。共同暴露如何影响整个妊娠期的胎盘形态和营养转运仍不清楚。我们假设，共同暴露对胎盘形态和营养转运体表达的影响会大于任一单独暴露。C57BL/6J小鼠在妊娠前及整个妊娠期间被喂以对照（CON）或高脂（HF）饮食，并在妊娠日（GD）12.5、15.5或18.5暴露于poly(I:C)或溶媒。分别通过苏木精和伊红染色、免疫组织化学（报告为免疫反应性（ir）染色面积百分比）和qPCR评估胎盘形态、叶酸和脂肪酸转运体mRNA表达及定位。在GD12.5，HF饮食与交界区（JZ）面积减少和母体血窦增加相关，随后在GD15.5出现胎儿血窦减少，到GD18.5时JZ和迷路区（LZ）面积增大。HF饮食和病毒感染在GD12.5分别与胎盘Fat/Cd36 mRNA表达增加相关。然而，HF饮食和感染与ir-FR-增加相关，而单独HF饮食在GD12.5降低ir-PCFT。到GD15.5，HF饮食与胎盘ir-FR-减少但ir-PCFT增加相关。在GD18.5，感染与Rfc1 mRNA表达减少相关。HF饮食和感染与SGA和LGA胎儿的患病率更高相关，尤其是在GD18.5。肥胖和感染以区域和妊娠年龄特异性的方式独立并共同扰乱胎盘形态和营养转运体表达，并对整个妊娠期的胎儿生长产生影响。

papers.title: Structural features and conservation of the lncRNA HOTAIR in primates
papers.translated_title: 灵长类动物中lncRNA HOTAIR的结构特征与保守性
papers.author: Perry, Z. R.
papers.summary: Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) regulate diverse cellular processes and are frequently implicated in disease, but their functional mechanisms often remain elusive. One such lncRNA, HOTAIR (Hox transcript antisense intergenic RNA), is a ~2.1 kb mammalian transcript whose overexpression promotes invasion and metastasis in breast cancer. However, the mechanisms by which HOTAIR influences gene regulation in cancer are poorly understood. To approach this problem through a structural lens, we predicted the full-length in cellulo secondary structure of HOTAIR using chemical probing in a metastatic breast cancer cell line. The resulting structure shows that HOTAIR adopts a multidomain architecture and has local structural features unique to the cellular context. Comparison between in vitro and in cellulo chemical probing identifies regions of differential accessibility that may indicate context-dependent molecular interactions or folding. Conservation analyses further reveal that HOTAIR is conserved across primates with evidence of structural covariation in specific domains. Together, these results provide a roadmap for future mechanistic studies of structure-function relationships in HOTAIR and its contribution to gene regulation in cancer.
papers.translated_summary: 长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）调控多种细胞过程，并常与疾病相关，但其功能机制往往仍不明确。其中一个这样的lncRNA，HOTAIR（Hox转录本反义基因间RNA），是一种约2.1 kb的哺乳动物转录本，其过表达促进乳腺癌的侵袭和转移。然而，HOTAIR影响癌症基因调控的机制尚知之甚少。为了从结构角度探讨这一问题，我们利用化学探测在转移性乳腺癌细胞系中预测了HOTAIR的全长细胞内二级结构。所得结构显示HOTAIR采用多结构域架构，并具有细胞环境所特有的局部结构特征。体外与细胞内化学探测的比较识别出差异可及性区域，这可能指示环境依赖的分子相互作用或折叠。保守性分析进一步揭示HOTAIR在灵长类动物中保守，并具有特定结构域中结构共变异的证据。总之，这些结果为未来研究HOTAIR中结构-功能关系及其在癌症基因调控中贡献的机制提供了路线图。

papers.title: Synthetic genetic circuits that count developmental cues in plant roots
papers.translated_title: 在植物根部计数发育信号的合成基因回路
papers.author: Choi, S.
papers.summary: Plants explore soil environments through their roots, which branch repeatedly to access water and soil-borne nutrients. In many plants, root branches are generated by repeated developmental programs and molecular analyses have not identified markers that distinguish primary from later root branches. Consequently, efforts to engineer plant roots for improved water or nutrient acquisition are limited to changes that affect the entire root system. Here, we developed synthetic genetic circuits to count repeating root development cues and enable differential gene expression in successive root branches of the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. The circuits use a root primordium-specific promoter to express large serine recombinases, which irreversibly invert segments of DNA each time a new lateral root is initiated. This converts repeating rounds of root formation into distinct, heritable DNA states. Because root branch specification and outgrowth occur over a ~2 day period, we tested circuit designs for their ability to count long-duration input pulses and developed an architecture that produces distinct fluorescence outputs in primary, secondary, and tertiary roots. By linking repeated developmental cues to distinct genetic outputs, synthetic genetic circuits that count enable root system engineering at the resolution of individual branches and offer a general strategy for dissecting developmental processes that rely on repeated signals.
papers.translated_summary: 植物通过根系探索土壤环境，根系反复分枝以获取水分和土壤中的养分。在许多植物中，根分枝由重复的发育程序产生，而分子分析尚未鉴定出能够区分初生根分枝与后续根分枝的标志物。因此，为改善水分或养分获取而改造植物根系的努力仅限于影响整个根系的变化。在此，我们开发了合成基因电路，用于计数重复的根系发育信号，并在模式植物拟南芥的连续根分枝中实现差异基因表达。这些电路利用根原基特异性启动子表达大型丝氨酸重组酶，每当新侧根起始时，这些酶不可逆地翻转DNA片段。这将重复的根系形成轮次转化为不同的、可遗传的DNA状态。由于根分枝特化和生长发生在约2天的时间内，我们测试了电路设计对长持续时间输入脉冲的计数能力，并开发了一种架构，在原根、二级根和三级根中产生不同的荧光输出。通过将重复的发育信号与不同的遗传输出相连接，计数型合成基因电路使根系工程能够在单个分枝的分辨率上进行，并为剖析依赖重复信号的发育过程提供了一种通用策略。

papers.title: Molecular sterics guide tmRNA translocation on the ribosome
papers.translated_title: 分子空间位阻引导核糖体上的tmRNA转运
papers.author: Wanes, G.
papers.summary: Translation of defective mRNA transcripts can lead to the formation of stalled ``non-stop'' ribosome complexes. To rescue these ribosomes, bacteria have evolved a mechanism called trans-translation that is mediated by transfer-messenger RNA (tmRNA) and small protein B (SmpB). During the translocation step of trans-translation, the stalled mRNA is ejected and the reading frame found in the mRNA-like domain (MLD) of tmRNA is loaded into the mRNA channel. The ribosome then translates the new template, thereby tagging the nascent protein for degradation. While structures of tmRNA-SmpB on the ribosome have been available for years, little is known about the molecular factors that govern the dynamics of tmRNA translocation. Here, we use an energetically smooth model (i.e. SMOG) to simulate translocation of tmRNA-SmpB, which reveals that the structure of the ribosome gives rise to a preferred sequence of conformational substeps. Specifically, the tRNA-like domain (TLD) translocates, then the MLD loads, and finally the C-terminal tail of SmpB rearranges. These steps are interdependent and associated with a range of sterically-induced barriers that regulate the kinetics. This provides a structural and energetic framework for understanding, and ultimately controlling, the dynamics of trans-translation.
papers.translated_summary: 缺陷mRNA转录本的翻译可能导致停滞的“非终止”核糖体复合物形成。为拯救这些核糖体，细菌演化出一种称为反式翻译的机制，该机制由转移信使RNA（tmRNA）和小蛋白B（SmpB）介导。在反式翻译的易位步骤中，停滞的mRNA被排出，tmRNA的类mRNA结构域（MLD）中的阅读框被加载到mRNA通道中。随后核糖体翻译这一新模板，从而将新生蛋白标记为降解对象。尽管tmRNA-SmpB在核糖体上的结构已有多年的研究，但人们对调控tmRNA易位动力学的分子因素知之甚少。在此，我们使用能量平滑模型（即SMOG）模拟tmRNA-SmpB的易位，揭示出核糖体的结构产生了一种优选的构象子步骤顺序。具体而言，类tRNA结构域（TLD）先易位，随后MLD加载，最后SmpB的C端尾部重排。这些步骤相互依赖，并伴随一系列空间位阻诱导的能垒，从而调控动力学。这为理解并最终控制反式翻译的动力学提供了结构与能量框架。

papers.title: Amide I kurtosis maps cardiac amyloid in human tissue by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy
papers.translated_title: 酰胺I峰峰度通过超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）显微镜在人体组织中对心脏淀粉样变性进行成像
papers.author: Ota, K.
papers.summary: Cardiac amyloidosis is caused by deposits of misfolded proteins in the heart and can lead to heart failure. Histological confirmation typically involves staining tissue sections with Congo red and examining them under polarized light for apple-green birefringence; however, achieving an interpretable, label-free, and observer-independent assessment remains challenging. Here we show that Pearson kurtosis of channel intensities within the amide I window provides an interpretable, fitting-free contrast for cardiac amyloid in unstained human cardiac tissue sections from ten participants imaged by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS). In a discovery participant, high-kurtosis regions corresponded with Congo red-positive tissue in two CARS-histology pairs of adjacent sections (descriptive spatial AUCs, 0.79 and 0.73). Across 15 fields from nine additional participants, field-level kurtosis values did not overlap between severe-deposition and Congo red-negative tissue fields. Among the descriptors examined, kurtosis showed the largest standardized participant-level separation. Exploratory multivariate curve resolution yielded a deposit-associated component with aromatic-residue features shared with reagent transthyretin. In one field from the discovery participant, the second harmonic generation (SHG) signal, acquired simultaneously with CARS, showed a broadly inverse spatial pattern relative to the amide I kurtosis map, revealing distinct tissue-architectural contrast. Together, these findings support a potential label-free approach to detecting cardiac amyloid deposits that combines amide I kurtosis derived from broadband CARS with SHG-derived architectural contrast.
papers.translated_summary: 心脏淀粉样变性由错误折叠蛋白在心脏中的沉积引起，可导致心力衰竭。组织学确认通常涉及用刚果红染色组织切片，并在偏振光下检查苹果绿双折射；然而，实现可解释、无标记且不依赖观察者的评估仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们表明，酰胺I窗口内通道强度的皮尔逊峰度可为来自十名参与者的未染色人类心脏组织切片中的心脏淀粉样变性提供可解释、无需拟合的对比，这些切片通过超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）成像。在一名发现参与者中，高蜂度区域与两对相邻切片的CARS-组织学配对中刚果红阳性组织相对应（描述性空间AUC分别为0.79和0.73）。在来自另外九名参与者的15个视野中，严重沉积与刚果红阴性组织视野之间的视野级峰度值没有重叠。在所检查的描述符中，峰度显示出最大的标准化参与者级分离。探索性多元曲线分辨产生了一个与沉积相关的组分，其具有与试剂运甲状腺素蛋白共享的芳香残基特征。在发现参与者的一个视野中，与CARS同时获取的二次谐波产生（SHG）信号相对于酰胺I峰度图显示出广泛相反的空间模式，揭示了不同的组织结构对比。总之，这些发现支持一种潜在的无标记方法，用于检测心脏淀粉样变性沉积，该方法将源自宽带CARS的酰胺I峰度与源自SHG的结构对比相结合。

papers.title: Potassium modulates Phytophthora zoospore motility and flagellar beating through dose-dependent effects
papers.translated_title: 钾通过剂量依赖性效应调节疫霉游动孢子的运动性和鞭毛摆动。
papers.author: Lupatelli, C. A.
papers.summary: Biflagellate zoospores are critical agents in the spread of Phytophthora spp., plant pathogens causing major agronomic and economic losses worldwide. These motile cells navigate soil water films toward plant roots using taxis triggered by environmental cues. Here, we investigate how potassium modulates zoospore motility by analyzing trajectory and flagellar beating parameters across KCl concentrations. Using high-speed imaging, we apply kymograph analysis and Fourier transform of the cell body direction over time to quantify flagellar dynamics, while low-speed imaging provides trajectory characteristics. Our results demonstrate that increasing potassium concentration significantly reduces swimming speed while enhancing directional changes. We establish a direct correlation between altered swimming speed and changes in flagellar beating parameters. Our findings indicate that potassium differentially affects anterior and posterior flagella beating. Furthermore, potassium exerts multiple effects, influencing beat amplitude, wave propagation speed and direction- change frequency. This reveals potassium as a key modulator of zoospore motility, triggering a shift from exploratory swimming to confined, reoriented movement. By uncovering the biomechanical responses of zoospores to potassium, this study advances our understanding of how surrounding signals regulate pathogen dispersal in the environment.
papers.translated_summary: 双鞭毛游动孢子是疫霉属病原菌传播的关键因子，这类植物病原菌在全球范围内造成重大农业和经济损失。这些运动细胞利用环境信号触发的趋性，在土壤水膜中朝向植物根系游动。本研究通过分析不同KCl浓度下的运动轨迹和鞭毛摆动参数，探究钾离子如何调控游动孢子的运动性。我们采用高速成像技术，对细胞体方向随时间的变化进行运动轨迹图分析和傅里叶变换，以量化鞭毛动力学，同时利用低速成像获取轨迹特征。结果表明，钾离子浓度升高显著降低游动速度，同时增强方向改变。我们建立了游动速度变化与鞭毛摆动参数变化之间的直接相关性。研究发现，钾离子对前鞭毛和后鞭毛的摆动具有差异化影响。此外，钾离子发挥多重效应，影响摆动幅度、波传播速度和方向改变频率。这揭示钾离子是游动孢子运动性的关键调控因子，触发从探索性游动向受限、重新定向运动的转变。通过揭示游动孢子对钾离子的生物力学响应，本研究推进了我们对周围信号如何调控病原菌在环境中扩散的理解。

papers.title: STRUCTURAL AND MOLECULAR DYNAMICS ANALYSIS OF HUMAN β-DEFENSIN 1 VARIANTS REVEALS DISTINCT PERTURBATION SIGNATURES
papers.translated_title: 人类β-防御素1变体的结构与分子动力学分析揭示不同的扰动特征
papers.author: Fogarty, R. J.
papers.summary: Human {beta}-defensin 1 (hBD-1) is a small, disulfide-constrained antimicrobial peptide produced predominantly in the kidney and urogenital tract, where it contributes to epithelial innate defense. Genetic variation in the gene encoding hBD-1 has been associated with altered expression levels and susceptibility to infections, including infection following solid organ transplantation, yet the molecular consequences of coding substitutions in the active, mature form remain largely undefined. Here, we integrate conventional genomics, protein bioinformatics, structural modeling, and molecular dynamics to investigate the molecular consequences of 93 human-observed hBD-1 missense variants. Evaluation of hBD-1 missense variants across sequence-, structure-, and dynamics-based dimensions reveals variant-specific molecular perturbation signatures that complement conventional and static biophysical predictions. By treating naturally occurring substitutions as a perturbation series across a compact defensin scaffold, this study identifies multiple molecular routes through which sequence variation can remodel an endogenous antimicrobial peptide and prioritizes variants for direct structure-function testing. These findings provide a mechanistic framework for investigating how naturally occurring hBD-1 variation may influence peptide behavior and, ultimately, antimicrobial function.
papers.translated_summary: 人β防御素1（hBD-1）是一种小型、二硫键约束的抗菌肽，主要在肾脏和泌尿生殖道中产生，参与上皮先天防御。编码hBD-1的基因的遗传变异与表达水平改变及感染易感性相关，包括实体器官移植后感染，但活性成熟形式中编码区替换的分子后果在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们整合了传统基因组学、蛋白质生物信息学、结构建模和分子动力学，以研究93种人类观察到的hBD-1错义变异的分子后果。在基于序列、结构和动力学的维度上评估hBD-1错义变异，揭示了变异特异性的分子扰动特征，这些特征补充了传统和静态生物物理预测。通过将自然发生的替换视为紧凑防御素支架上的扰动序列，本研究识别了序列变异可重塑内源性抗菌肽的多种分子途径，并优先选择变异进行直接的结构-功能测试。这些发现为研究自然发生的hBD-1变异如何影响肽行为并最终影响抗菌功能提供了机制框架。

papers.title: Fine-mapping HLA-II haplotypes in Alzheimer's disease and healthy longevity reveals distinct associations with microglial HLA-II load and neuropathology
papers.translated_title: 在阿尔茨海默病和健康长寿中对HLA-II单倍型进行精细定位，揭示了其与小胶质细胞HLA-II负荷和神经病理学的不同关联。
papers.author: Alvarez Sirvent, D.
papers.summary: Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) class II variation is implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and longevity, but its mechanisms within the major histocompatibility complex remain unclear. We fine-mapped seven independent HLA-II haplotypes in 6,053 individuals (443 cognitively healthy centenarians [CHCs], 3,219 population controls, 2,391 AD patients). Three haplotypes overlapped previous AD and lifespan signals. Hap-B (DRB1*04subtypes) was protective, enriched in CHCs and controls versus AD, with its neuroprotective association with tau pathology replicated in an independent Netherlands Brain Bank cohort. Hap-R (DRB1*01:01) increased AD risk and reduced healthy longevity, with reduced microglial HLA-II activation. Hap-Y (DRB1*15:01) showed increased microglial HLA-II activation in post-mortem brain tissue, independent of quantitative AD neuropathology. These findings indicate distinct HLA-II haplotypes shape AD susceptibility and healthy longevity through separate mechanisms, linking HLA architecture to brain immune states beyond classical neuropathology.
papers.translated_summary: 人类白细胞抗原（HLA）II类变异与阿尔茨海默病（AD）和长寿相关，但其在主要组织相容性复合体内部的作用机制仍不清楚。我们对6，053名个体（443名认知健康百岁老人[CHC]、3，219名人群对照、2，391名AD患者）中的七个独立HLA-II单倍型进行了精细定位。三个单倍型与既往AD和寿命信号重叠。Hap-B（DRB1*04亚型）具有保护作用，在CHC和对照中较AD富集，其与tau病理的神经保护关联在一个独立的荷兰脑库队列中得到了重复验证。Hap-R（DRB1*01:01）增加AD风险并降低健康长寿，同时伴有小胶质细胞HLA-II激活减少。Hap-Y（DRB1*15:01）在死后脑组织中显示小胶质细胞HLA-II激活增加，且独立于定量AD神经病理。这些发现表明，不同的HLA-II单倍型通过不同机制塑造AD易感性和健康长寿，将HLA结构与超越经典神经病理的脑免疫状态联系起来。

papers.title: Machine Learning-Supported Efficient VTE Risk Assessment using Routinely Collected Electronic Health Record Data
papers.translated_title: 机器学习支持的利用常规收集的电子健康记录数据进行高效VTE风险评估
papers.author: Li, Z.
papers.summary: Objective: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a leading cause of preventable inpatient mortality, while the real-world performance of mandated risk assessment and the potential for automating using electronic health record (EHR) data remain unclear. We evaluated completion, concordance with structured EHR data, clinical validity, and feasibility of EHR-supported VTE risk assessment assisted by machine learning. Materials and Methods: We analysed 577,904 admissions and 726,896 VTE assessment forms across five NHS hospitals between 2015 and 2025. Concordance and clinical validity were evaluated in 87,118 completed assessments from 2023 to 2024. Machine learning models compared clinician-recorded and EHR-derived risk factors in 74,372 encounters with an assessment completed within 14 hours of admission. Results: Overall completion was 96.7%, and timely completion improved from 47.4% in 2015 to 90.5% in 2024. Agreement between forms and EHR data was good for common risk factors (e.g. age over 60 years: precision 0.95, recall 0.77), but low-prevalence variables were often under-documented in the forms (e.g. critical care admission: precision 0.20, recall 0.14). Despite these discrepancies, form-derived thrombosis risk was associated with increased VTE incidence (adjusted OR 3.31, 95% CI 2.81-3.90). Models using EHR-derived factors available within 14 hours achieved an AUROC of 0.709, compared with 0.704 for clinician-recorded variables. Discussion: Much of the information the risk assessment requires already exists in structured EHR data, and EHR-derived variables contained discriminative information comparable to that in clinician-recorded factors. Conclusion: Routinely collected EHR data could support real-time pre-population of structured VTE assessments, thereby reducing documentation burden while preserving clinical validity.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：静脉血栓栓塞症（VTE）是可预防的住院死亡的主要原因之一，而强制性风险评估在真实世界中的执行情况以及利用电子健康记录（EHR）数据实现自动化的潜力仍不明确。我们评估了由机器学习辅助的、EHR支持的VTE风险评估的完成率、与结构化EHR数据的一致性、临床有效性及可行性。材料与方法：我们分析了2015年至2025年间五家NHS医院的577,904例入院记录和726,896份VTE评估表。在2023年至2024年的87,118份已完成评估中评价了一致性和临床有效性。机器学习模型在74,372例于入院14小时内完成评估的病例中，比较了临床医生记录的危险因素与EHR衍生的危险因素。结果：总体完成率为96.7%，及时完成率从2015年的47.4%提高至2024年的90.5%。评估表与EHR数据在常见危险因素上的一致性良好（例如年龄超过60岁：精确率0.95，召回率0.77），但低患病率变量在评估表中常记录不足（例如重症监护入院：精确率0.20，召回率0.14）。尽管存在这些差异，评估表衍生的血栓风险仍与VTE发生率升高相关（校正OR 3.31，95% CI 2.81-3.90）。使用入院14小时内可获得的EHR衍生因素的模型达到AUROC 0.709，而临床医生记录变量的模型为0.704。讨论：风险评估所需的大部分信息已存在于结构化EHR数据中，且EHR衍生变量所含的判别信息与临床医生记录因素相当。结论：常规收集的EHR数据可支持结构化VTE评估的实时预填充，从而在保持临床有效性的同时减轻记录负担。

papers.title: HPV binding antibodies are associated with protection: a meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: HPV结合抗体与保护作用相关：一项荟萃分析
papers.author: Berry, M. T.
papers.summary: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the major cause of cervical cancer globally. Current vaccines have shown high efficacy at preventing HPV infection and other surrogate disease endpoints in randomised controlled trials (RCT). However, uptake is limited by accessibility and cost. Rapid clinical evaluation is critical for shortening time-to-market and encouraging the development and deployment of affordable vaccines. We aim to establish a validated correlate of protection that will support vaccine developers and decision makers with vaccine development, approval, dose schedules and deployment decisions. Methods: We utilised three existing Cochrane Systematic Reviews of RCTs of HPV vaccines and extended these to 1st January 2026. We identified and extracted data from trials where both efficacy and immunogenicity (HPV-specific antibodies) were reported. For HPV types where vaccine efficacy was reported but not immunogenicity (Types 31/33/45/52/58) we sourced antibody binding concentrations from separate immunogenicity studies. We linked antibody binding concentrations from each RCT to the corresponding vaccine efficacy data, matching by study, vaccine arm, number of doses, and HPV type. We use a Bayesian framework in a model-based meta-analysis to examine the association between antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy. Findings: Combining data on both vaccine-targeted and non-targeted HPV types, we find an association between type-specific antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy against the three HPV outcomes tested: incident infection, persistent infection and grade 2 or 3 cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2+) (p<0.0005, for all outcomes). We also compared this association with data from studies of natural infection, which had shown an association between antibody binding concentrations and risk of infection. This demonstrated that the association between vaccine-induced antibodies and vaccine efficacy was well aligned with the existing HPV literature on correlates of risk from natural exposure. Finally, we find evidence that the antibody concentrations associated with 50% (of the maximal) vaccine efficacy differ by type (p<0.0005, for example 16 sIU/ml for HPV58, but <0.5 IU/ml for HPV 16/18). Interpretations: HPV type-specific antibody binding concentrations are associated with protection against HPV related clinical outcomes, across different HPV types and vaccines, and after natural infection. The consistent observation that antibody binding concentrations correlate with protection provides support for the use of antibody binding for immunobridging, for example in non-inferiority studies when assessing similar vaccines. Funding: This work is supported by National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia and the University of New South Wales.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是全球宫颈癌的主要病因。现有疫苗在随机对照试验（RCT）中已显示出在预防HPV感染及其他替代疾病终点方面具有高效力。然而，其接种普及受到可及性和成本的限制。快速临床评估对于缩短上市时间、鼓励可负担疫苗的开发和部署至关重要。我们旨在建立经过验证的保护相关因素，以支持疫苗开发者和决策者在疫苗开发、审批、剂量方案和部署决策方面的工作。方法：我们利用了三个现有的Cochrane系统评价（针对HPV疫苗的RCT），并将其数据扩展至2026年1月1日。我们从同时报告效力（efficacy）和免疫原性（HPV特异性抗体）的试验中识别并提取数据。对于报告了疫苗效力但未报告免疫原性的HPV型别（31/33/45/52/58型），我们从单独的免疫原性研究中获取抗体结合浓度。我们将每项RCT中的抗体结合浓度与相应的疫苗效力数据相关联，按研究、疫苗组别、剂次和HPV型别进行匹配。我们采用基于模型的荟萃分析中的贝叶斯框架，检验抗体结合浓度与疫苗效力之间的关联。结果：结合疫苗靶向和非靶向HPV型别的数据，我们发现型特异性抗体结合浓度与针对三种HPV结局的疫苗效力之间存在关联：新发感染、持续性感染和2级或3级宫颈上皮内瘤变（CIN2+）（所有结局p<0.0005）。我们还将这一关联与自然感染研究的数据进行了比较，后者已显示抗体结合浓度与感染风险之间存在关联。这表明疫苗诱导抗体与疫苗效力之间的关联与现有关于自然暴露风险相关因素的HPV文献高度一致。最后，我们发现证据表明，与50%（最大）疫苗效力相关的抗体浓度因型别而异（p<0.0005，例如HPV58为16 sIU/ml，而HPV 16/18为<0.5 IU/ml）。解释：HPV型特异性抗体结合浓度与针对HPV相关临床结局的保护作用相关，且这一关联跨越不同HPV型别和疫苗，并在自然感染后同样成立。抗体结合浓度与保护作用相关这一一致性观察结果，为使用抗体结合进行免疫桥接提供了支持，例如在评估类似疫苗的非劣效性研究中。资助：本工作由澳大利亚国家健康与医学研究委员会和新南威尔士大学资助。

papers.title: Expression of specific var gene subtypes is associated with distinct severe malaria syndromes
papers.translated_title: 特定var基因亚型的表达与不同的重症疟疾综合征相关
papers.author: Ndugwa, H.
papers.summary: The virulence of Plasmodium falciparum is closely linked to P. falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein 1 (PfEMP1), encoded by the diverse var gene family. PfEMP1 mediates parasite immune evasion and vascular adhesion of infected red blood cells, contributing to severe disease. While expression of group A or domain cassette (DC8 and DC13)-containing var genes have been associated with severe malaria, direct comparisons between the severe malaria syndromes remain limited. Furthermore, interactions between specific var gene expression and the rosetting phenotype, a known marker of severe malaria, are incompletely understood across severe malaria syndromes. We analysed parasite and clinical data from 966 Kenyan children with non-severe malaria and severe malaria syndromes collected over 18 years in Kilifi, Kenya. Var gene transcription was profiled using DBL-tag sequencing (n=898), RT-qPCR (n=768), and DBL-tag-based prediction tools. We show that parasites expressing group A or DC8 var genes were associated with impaired consciousness (IC), while rosetting was associated with respiratory distress (RD) and severe malarial anaemia (SMA), but not IC. Variant expression was more homogeneous in SMA than IC or RD. These findings suggest that IC, RD and SMA reflect distinct underlying parasite virulence strategies: sequestration, rosetting associated parasite virulence, and chronicity of infection respectively. In conclusion, this analysis provides the most comprehensive characterisation of P. falciparum var gene expression across the major severe malaria syndromes to date and highlights the possibility of syndrome-specific parasite virulence mechanisms that may inform the development of targeted therapeutic interventions
papers.translated_summary: 恶性疟原虫的毒力与恶性疟原虫红细胞膜蛋白1（PfEMP1）密切相关，后者由高度多样的var基因家族编码。PfEMP1介导寄生虫免疫逃逸及感染红细胞的血管黏附，从而导致重症疾病。尽管A组或含结构域盒（DC8和DC13）的var基因表达与重症疟疾相关，但不同重症疟疾综合征之间的直接比较仍有限。此外，特定var基因表达与玫瑰花结形成表型（重症疟疾的已知标志）之间的相互作用在不同重症疟疾综合征中尚未完全阐明。我们分析了在肯尼亚基利菲地区历时18年收集的966名肯尼亚儿童（非重症疟疾和重症疟疾综合征）的寄生虫及临床数据。采用DBL-tag测序（n=898）、RT-qPCR（n=768）及基于DBL-tag的预测工具对var基因转录进行图谱分析。我们发现，表达A组或DC8 var基因的寄生虫与意识受损（IC）相关，而玫瑰花结形成与呼吸窘迫（RD）和重症疟疾贫血（SMA）相关，但与IC无关。SMA中的变异体表达比IC或RD更为均一。这些发现提示，IC、RD和SMA分别反映了不同的潜在寄生虫毒力策略：隔离、玫瑰花结形成相关的寄生虫毒力以及感染的慢性化。总之，本分析提供了迄今为止对主要重症疟疾综合征中恶性疟原虫var基因表达最为全面的表征，并揭示了综合征特异性寄生虫毒力机制的可能性，这可能为靶向治疗干预措施的开发提供依据。

papers.title: WITHDRAWN: How to Detect the Early Cardiac Functional Change and Predict Heart Failure in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation? A Prospective Cohort Study
papers.translated_title: 已撤回：如何检测阵发性心房颤动中的早期心脏功能变化并预测心力衰竭？一项前瞻性队列研究
papers.author: Cheng, L.
papers.summary: Backgrounds20-30% atrial fibrillation (AF) may result in heart failure (HF). Noninvasive left ventricle myocardial work (LVMW) is a fairly new method for detecting LV function. We aimed to evaluate whether LVMW could detect the LV change function in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) and predict HF incident. MethodsIn this prospective cohort study, 146 PAF subjects and 63 non-PAF subjects matched by age and gender set as the controls were enrolled. Noninvasive LVMW parameters, including global work index, global constructive work, global wasted work (GWW) and global work efficiency (GWE) were obtained from LV pressure-strain loop by 2D speckle tracking imaging. LA volume index (LAVI) was measured by 3D echocardiography. AF burden (AFB) was evaluated by questionnaire. The primary outcome was the incident HF.AFB deterioration was evaluated at the end of follow up. Stata15.0 and R4.1 were used for data analysis and description. ResultsThe average age was 66.2{+/-}11.4 years and comprised 55% males in PAF. Compared with the controls, PAF had significantly elevated GWW (143.7{+/-}88.3mmHg% vs 115.5{+/-}59.6mmHg%, p<0.001) and impaired GWE (92.3{+/-}7.5% vs 93.8{+/-}2.8%, p=0.035) and they were correlated with increased LAVImax and LAVImin. Those with higher AFB showed significantly decreased LAEF and increased LAVImin. During the average 40.5 months follow-up, 9.9% PAF developed HF and ablation reduced the HF occurrence. In the non-ablation subgroup, baseline decreased LAEF rather than LVMW was a strong predictor for HF. As expected, AFB deterioration was strongly associated with HF incident. ConclusionsElevated GWW was detected by LVMW and it was strongly correlated with LA dilation in PAF. Higher AFB had adverse effect on LAVImin. Restoring sinus rhythm was significant for HF prevention, especially for PAF with lower LAEF. papers.translated_summary: 背景：20-30%的房颤（AF）可能导致心力衰竭（HF）。无创左心室心肌做功（LVMW）是一种检测左心室功能的新方法。我们旨在评估LVMW是否能检测阵发性房颤（PAF）的左心室功能变化并预测HF发生。方法：在这项前瞻性队列研究中，纳入146例PAF受试者和63例按年龄和性别匹配的非PAF受试者作为对照组。通过二维斑点追踪成像从左心室压力-应变环获取无创LVMW参数，包括整体做功指数、整体 constructive work、整体无效做功（GWW）和整体做功效率（GWE）。通过三维超声心动图测量左心房容积指数（LAVI）。通过问卷评估房颤负荷（AFB）。主要结局为新发HF。在随访结束时评估AFB恶化。使用Stata15.0和R4.1进行数据分析和描述。结果：PAF组平均年龄为66.2±11.4岁，男性占55%。与对照组相比，PAF组的GWW显著升高（143.7±88.3mmHg% vs 115.5±59.6mmHg%，p<0.001），GWE受损（92.3±7.5% vs 93.8±2.8%，p=0.035），且它们与LAVImax和LAVImin增加相关。AFB较高的患者左心房射血分数（LAEF）显著降低，LAVImin增加。在平均40.5个月的随访期间，9.9%的PAF患者发生HF，消融降低了HF发生率。在非消融亚组中，基线LAEF降低而非LVMW是HF的强预测因子。正如预期，AFB恶化与HF发生密切相关。结论：LVMW检测到GWW升高，且其与PAF中的左心房扩张密切相关。较高的AFB对LAVImin有不良影响。恢复窦性心律对预防HF具有重要意义，尤其是对于LAEF较低的PAF患者。临床视角：有什么新发现？尽管整体纵向应变（GLS）和左心室射血分数（LVEF）仍正常，但在PAF早期，LVMW可检测到GWW升高和GWE受损所反映的细微左心室功能障碍。LAVImin增加而非LAEF与PAF中GWW升高和较高房颤负荷密切相关。恢复窦性心律对早期PAF预防HF很重要，尤其是LAEF较低的PAF患者。临床意义是什么？对于PAF患者，即使从非常早期阶段开始，通过维持窦性心律或将AFB保持在最小-轻度阶段来保护左心室功能具有重要意义。LAVImin增加是检测PAF左心室功能障碍的重要指标，其潜在机制有待发现。

papers.title: Agreement between an artificial intelligence video-analysis platform and human evaluators scoring emergency medical technician psychomotor skills: a fully crossed reliability study
papers.translated_title: 人工智能视频分析平台与人类评估者在紧急医疗技术员精神运动技能评分上的一致性：一项完全交叉可靠性研究
papers.author: Otte, J. H.
papers.summary: BackgroundA primary constraint on the capacity of EMS programs to meet industry demand is psychomotor instruction and verification--requiring direct observation of each student by a qualified evaluator. Whether AI video analysis can relieve it is untested; none has been applied to EMS skill examination or compared with human examiners. ObjectiveTo quantify human EMS evaluator inter-rater reliability and evaluate an AI video-analysis platform against it. MethodsIn a prospective, fully crossed study, five certified EMS evaluators and an AI platform independently scored identical video-recorded EMT performances of cervical collar application (n=15), bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation (n=14), and medical assessment (n=15) on dichotomous checklists with critical-failure criteria. Agreement was assessed at item, score, and decision levels using Fleiss {kappa}, Krippendorffs , Gwets AC1, and ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k). ResultsHuman item agreement was moderate ({kappa} 0.409-0.467), as was single-rater reliability (ICC(2,1) 0.539-0.694), against good panel reliability (ICC(2,k) 0.854-0.919). Recorded pass/fail agreement was fair ({kappa} 0.297-0.388) and critical-failure agreement near zero for two skills ({kappa} 0.028, 0.119). AI alignment tracked rubric observability rather than task complexity: r = 0.857 (collar, exceeding every human), -0.173 (BVM), 0.664 (medical), and it was most lenient on two skills. ConclusionsHuman evaluators are an imperfect standard, especially on critical failures. The AI was a legitimate additional rater where checklist items were discrete and visually verifiable, but not where credit required judging continuous quantities such as ventilation rate, volume, or suction duration. Defensible uses are formative and archival, not summative. These results reflect an early, non-specialist configuration--a baseline, not a limit.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：EMS项目满足行业需求的能力受到一个主要制约，即精神运动技能教学与验证——需要由合格评估者对每位学生进行直接观察。AI视频分析能否缓解这一制约尚未得到检验；尚无此类技术被应用于EMS技能考核或与人类评估者进行比较。目的：量化人类EMS评估者之间的评分者间信度，并评估一个AI视频分析平台相对于该信度的表现。方法：在一项前瞻性、完全交叉研究中，五名认证EMS评估者和一个AI平台独立对相同的视频录制EMT操作表现进行评分，包括颈托应用（n=15）、球囊面罩（BVM）通气（n=14）和医学评估（n=15），使用具有关键失败标准的二分法核查表。在条目、分数和决策层面，使用Fleiss κ、Krippendorff α、Gwet AC1和ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k)评估一致性。结果：人类条目一致性为中等（κ 0.409-0.467），单评分者信度也为中等（ICC(2,1) 0.539-0.694），而小组信度为良好（ICC(2,k) 0.854-0.919）。记录的通过/不通过一致性为一般（κ 0.297-0.388），两项技能的关键失败一致性接近零（κ 0.028，0.119）。AI对齐程度更多反映评分标准的可观察性，而非任务复杂性：r = 0.857（颈托，超过所有人类），-0.173（BVM），0.664（医学评估），并且它在两项技能上最为宽松。结论：人类评估者是一个不完美的标准，尤其是在关键失败方面。在核查表条目离散且视觉可验证的情况下，AI是一个合理的额外评分者，但在评分需要判断连续量（如通气频率、潮气量或吸引持续时间）的情况下则不然。可辩护的用途是形成性和存档性，而非终结性。这些结果反映的是一个早期、非专科配置——是基线，而非极限。

papers.title: Prevalence of Enteric Hyperoxaluria in Crohn's Disease, Cystic Fibrosis, and After Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review
papers.translated_title: 克罗恩病、囊性纤维化及减重手术后肠源性高草酸尿症的患病率：一项系统综述
papers.author: Xing, X.
papers.summary: Abstract Background. Enteric hyperoxaluria (EH) causes calcium oxalate kidney stones, oxalate nephropathy, and chronic kidney disease (CKD), and can progress to end-stage kidney disease. It occurs in Crohn's disease (CD), cystic fibrosis (CF), chronic pancreatitis, celiac disease, short bowel syndrome, and after bariatric surgery. Its prevalence in these populations has not been synthesized. Methods. PROSPERO CRD420261364424. PubMed and Embase were searched to 24 August 2026 for studies reporting 24-hour urinary oxalate. Prevalence was pooled using the Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation with a DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model; unweighted crude prevalence is also reported. Because heterogeneity was high, the narrative synthesis stratified by testing condition is the primary result. Prespecified subgroups addressed oxalate load before collection, diagnostic threshold, ileal resection, age, and urine collection format. Results. Forty-seven studies were included. In CD (17 studies, 471 patients; 204 with EH), crude prevalence was 43.3% and pooled prevalence 49.3% (95% CI 38.9-59.8; I^2 = 95.3%). With an oxalate load, prevalence was 64.7% (pooled 74.0%, 55.9-88.6) versus 38.6% without (pooled 39.1%, 28.7-50.0). Among CD patients, EH was more frequent with ileal resection (48.8% vs 31.7%; OR 1.62, 0.91-2.89) and with steatorrhea (62.5% vs 29.3%; OR 9.88, 3.81-25.61). In CF (7 studies, 348 patients; 179 with EH), pooled prevalence was 49.8% (40.5-59.1; I^2 = 91.9%). After bariatric surgery (15 studies, 849 patients; 474 with EH), pooled prevalence was 54.7% (45.4-63.9; I^2 = 96.7%). Conclusions. Roughly half of these patients have EH, but the proportion depends heavily on whether an oxalate load precedes urine collection (39% unprovoked vs 65%-74% provoked); because most studies do not state this condition, published prevalence estimates are not directly comparable. Ileal resection and steatorrhea identify those who should be screened.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景。肠源性高草酸尿症（EH）可引起草酸钙肾结石、草酸盐肾病和慢性肾脏病（CKD），并可进展为终末期肾病。它发生于克罗恩病（CD）、囊性纤维化（CF）、慢性胰腺炎、乳糜泻、短肠综合征以及减重手术后。其在这些人群中的患病率尚未得到综合。方法。PROSPERO CRD420261364424。检索了PubMed和Embase至2026年8月24日，纳入报告24小时尿草酸盐的研究。采用Freeman-Tukey双反正弦变换结合DerSimonian-Laird随机效应模型合并患病率；同时报告未加权的粗患病率。由于异质性较高，按检测条件分层的叙述性综合为主要结果。预设亚组涉及采集前草酸盐负荷、诊断阈值、回肠切除、年龄和尿液采集形式。结果。共纳入47项研究。在CD中（17项研究，471例患者；204例患EH），粗患病率为43.3%，合并患病率为49.3%（95% CI 38.9-59.8；I^2 = 95.3%）。在有草酸盐负荷时，患病率为64.7%（合并74.0%，55.9-88.6），而无草酸盐负荷时为38.6%（合并39.1%，28.7-50.0）。在CD患者中，EH在回肠切除后更为常见（48.8% vs 31.7%；OR 1.62，0.91-2.89），在脂肪泻时也更为常见（62.5% vs 29.3%；OR 9.88，3.81-25.61）。在CF中（7项研究，348例患者；179例患EH），合并患病率为49.8%（40.5-59.1；I^2 = 91.9%）。减重手术后（15项研究，849例患者；474例患EH），合并患病率为54.7%（45.4-63.9；I^2 = 96.7%）。结论。这些患者中约有一半患有EH，但该比例在很大程度上取决于尿液采集前是否有草酸盐负荷（无激发时为39%，激发时为65%-74%）；由于大多数研究未说明这一条件，已发表的患病率估计值无法直接比较。回肠切除和脂肪泻可识别出应接受筛查的患者。

papers.title: Ecological momentary assessments predict clinical anxiety and depression status at 3 months post-stroke
papers.translated_title: 生态瞬时评估可预测卒中后3个月时的临床焦虑和抑郁状态
papers.author: Duttagupta, S.
papers.summary: Background: Stroke survivors frequently experience post-stroke depression (PSD) and post-stroke anxiety (PSA), which may be underexamined by clinicians if patient mood status between discharge and follow-up is unknown. Digital monitoring may enable early identification of mood disturbances. Ecological momentary assessments (EMA) have been tested to capture mood fluctuations in patients regular environments, but no standardized procedure for monitoring PSA or PSD has been developed. Objective: Determine the feasibility and validity of EMA for evaluating subacute PSA and PSD in non-severe stroke patients. Methods: Patients with non-severe stroke discharged home responded to daily smartphone EMA questions concerning mood and activity for twelve weeks until follow-up. Questions based on symptoms of anxiety and depression were used to derive EMA Anx and EMA Dep indices, computed over five 15-day intervals. Convergent validity was assessed using follow-up Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) and Centre for Epidemiological Studies-Depression (CES-D) scores. Logistic regression models predicted PSA and PSD status at follow-up, with baseline models comprising stroke severity, age, sex, and mood status, to which EMA Anx or Dep were added. Results: Data from 118 patients were analyzed. EMA adherence was moderate, with 89 patients (75.4%) responding on 75 or more days. Correlations between EMA Anx and GAD-7 and between EMA Dep and CES-D generally strengthened at later intervals, with the average mood index generally showing the strongest associations. Adding EMA data from the third time interval (31-45 days) significantly improved model fit beyond the baseline models (Anxiety: {chi}-square = 7.08, p = 0.008, {delta}R-square = 0.060; Depression: {chi}-square = 28.0, p < 0.001, {delta}R-square = 0.256). Discussion: EMA is feasible in mild-to-moderate stroke patients and may facilitate early identification of post-stroke mood disturbances. Further analyses in more diverse populations are required to validate these findings.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：卒中幸存者常出现卒中后抑郁（PSD）和卒中后焦虑（PSA），若患者出院至随访期间的情绪状态未知，临床医生可能对这些情况评估不足。数字化监测可能有助于早期识别情绪障碍。生态瞬时评估（EMA）已被用于捕捉患者在日常环境中的情绪波动，但目前尚未开发出用于监测PSA或PSD的标准化流程。目的：确定EMA用于评估非重症卒中患者亚急性期PSA和PSD的可行性及有效性。方法：非重症卒中出院回家的患者连续十二周每日通过智能手机回答有关情绪和活动的EMA问题，直至随访。基于焦虑和抑郁症状的问题用于推导EMA Anx和EMA Dep指数，分别在五个15天区间内计算。采用随访时的广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7（GAD-7）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）评分评估聚合效度。使用逻辑回归模型预测随访时的PSA和PSD状态，基线模型包括卒中严重程度、年龄、性别和情绪状态，随后加入EMA Anx或Dep。结果：分析了118例患者的数据。EMA依从性为中等，89例患者（75.4%）在75天或更长时间内作答。EMA Anx与GAD-7之间以及EMA Dep与CES-D之间的相关性通常在较晚区间增强，平均情绪指数通常显示出最强的关联。加入第三个时间区间（31-45天）的EMA数据后，模型拟合显著优于基线模型（焦虑：{chi}-square = 7.08，p = 0.008，{delta}R-square = 0.060；抑郁：{chi}-square = 28.0，p < 0.001，{delta}R-square = 0.256）。讨论：EMA在轻至中度卒中患者中可行，并可能有助于早期识别卒中后情绪障碍。需要在更多样化的人群中进一步分析以验证这些发现。

papers.title: Navigating Life After Dementia Diagnosis: Questions, Challenges, and Support Needs Among Dementia Dyads
papers.translated_title: 痴呆症诊断后的生活导航：痴呆症二人组合的问题、挑战和支持需求
papers.author: Britt, K.
papers.summary: Background: Older adults living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (AD/ADRD) and their care partners face substantial daily challenges that evolve with disease progression and extend far beyond the clinical setting, including symptom management, care coordination, healthcare navigation, and planning for future care needs. Understanding these challenges is essential for developing innovative solutions to provide ongoing and targeted support. In this study, we explored questions, challenges, and support needs experienced by dementia dyads following diagnosis to inform the development of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbot designed to provide ongoing support for dementia dyads. Methods: We recruited 11 community-dwelling dyads comprising persons living with MCI or mild AD/ADRD and their care partners, one additional care partner, and 12 dementia care experts from academic medical centers, clinics, and aging organizations in the U.S. We conducted semi-structured interviews and analyzed them using conventional content analysis. Results: Participants described interconnected questions, challenges, and support needs that evolved while navigating life with MCI or AD/ADRD. Questions centered around day-to-day care management, medical concerns, behavioral symptom management, diagnosis and prognosis, safety, and resources and services. Challenges included care partner overwhelm, limited dementia knowledge, condition-related uncertainty, healthcare system navigation difficulties, financial constraints, and technology-related barriers. Participants identified needs for ongoing education, personalized care planning, resource navigation, logistical support and follow-up, culturally responsive care, and social and emotional support. Conclusions: Dementia dyads experience substantial informational, emotional, and practical support needs in the early stages of MCI and AD/ADRD. Findings suggest that post-diagnostic support should extend beyond information provision alone to provide ongoing, personalized, and practical guidance that helps dyads navigate changing needs, resources, and everyday dementia care. These findings are informing the development of an AI-based chatbot intended to complement existing dementia care by extending access to education, practical guidance, and resource navigation between clinical encounters.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：患有轻度认知障碍（MCI）或阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（AD/ADRD）的老年人及其照护伙伴面临着巨大的日常挑战，这些挑战随着疾病进展而演变，并远远超出临床环境，包括症状管理、照护协调、医疗保健导航以及未来照护需求的规划。理解这些挑战对于开发创新解决方案以提供持续且有针对性支持至关重要。在本研究中，我们探讨了痴呆症二元组在诊断后所经历的问题、挑战和支持需求，以指导开发一款基于人工智能（AI）的聊天机器人，旨在为痴呆症二元组提供持续支持。方法：我们招募了11个社区居住的二元组，包括患有MCI或轻度AD/ADRD的人及其照护伙伴，另招募了1名照护伙伴，以及来自美国学术医疗中心、诊所和老龄化组织的12名痴呆症照护专家。我们进行了半结构化访谈，并使用传统内容分析法对其进行分析。结果：参与者描述了在应对MCI或AD/ADRD生活过程中不断演变且相互关联的问题、挑战和支持需求。问题集中在日常照护管理、医疗问题、行为症状管理、诊断和预后、安全以及资源和服务方面。挑战包括照护伙伴不堪重负、痴呆症知识有限、与疾病相关的不确定性、医疗保健系统导航困难、经济限制以及技术相关障碍。参与者确定了持续教育、个性化照护规划、资源导航、后勤支持和随访、文化响应性照护以及社交和情感支持的需求。结论：痴呆症二元组在MCI和AD/ADRD早期阶段经历了大量信息、情感和实践支持需求。研究结果表明，诊断后支持不应仅限于提供信息，而应提供持续、个性化和实用的指导，帮助二元组应对不断变化的需求、资源和日常痴呆症照护。这些发现正在指导开发一款基于AI的聊天机器人，旨在通过扩大临床就诊之间的教育、实用指导和资源导航的可及性，来补充现有的痴呆症照护。

papers.title: Learning-by-Doing to Adapt a Digital Community Engagement Strategy for Identifying and Reaching Zero-Dose Children in Kano State, Nigeria: A Program Case Study
papers.translated_title: 在尼日利亚卡诺州，通过边做边学调整数字社区参与策略以识别和覆盖零剂次儿童：一个项目案例研究
papers.author: Ahmad K.U Nagogo, A.
papers.summary: Background: Kano State has one of the highest concentrations of zero-dose (ZD) children in Nigeria, challenging equitable immunization coverage. Digital engagement tools meant to strengthen timely data to address such gaps often underperform due to limited adaptability to user needs. Learning-by-doing (LxD), which brings together human-centered design and adaptive management, offers more context-responsive solutions. Intervention and Implementation Approach: MCH-Track, a digital platform for tracking and referral for childhood vaccinations was used by 56 female community mobilizers in two local government areas (LGAs) out of the 44 LGAs in Kano State, Nigeria. We conducted a program case study from: 1) August 2024-April 2025 (initial implementation); and 2) adapted implementation (May 2025-November 2025), where LxD was incorporated to address emergent challenges. LxD included structured shadowing, monthly interviews with users, after-action reviews, and change log to track adaptations alongside routine services. Performance was monitored using four indicators: feedback actioned, response time-to-user feedback, ease-of-use score, and mobilizer performance in tracking ZD children. Findings: After incorporating LxD, 17 issues were identified and led to 12 prioritized adaptations. All logged issues received responses, with median response time declining to approximately two weeks, while community mobilizers reported higher usability of the digital platform (e.g., mean ease-of-use score of 4.1 out of 5). Enhanced root-cause analysis enabled trend tracking and clearer escalation pathways for systemic issues like micro-stockouts at immunization points. Empathy tool records revealed mobilizer struggles with platform. This was immediately logged, prompting user experience redesign into a seamless, single-step process from registration-to-referral. During the LxD implementation period, an average of 33 ZD children per month were identified via MCH-Track, a substantial increase from the pre-LxD period (an average of 11 ZD children identified per month). Average referral-to-access rates also improved during the LxD period, rising from 44% of identified and referred ZD children accessing immunization services pre-LxD to 70% after incorporating LxD practices. Conclusion: Embedding LxD within MCH-Track strengthened co-creation, streamlined workflows, and improved community mobilizer performance, demonstrating the value of adaptive management in reaching ZD children.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：卡诺州是尼日利亚零剂次（ZD）儿童集中度最高的地区之一，为实现公平的免疫接种覆盖带来了挑战。旨在加强及时数据以弥补此类缺口的数字参与工具往往表现不佳，原因在于其对用户需求的适应性有限。边做边学（LxD）将以人为本的设计与适应性管理相结合，提供了更具情境响应性的解决方案。干预与实施方法：MCH-Track是一个用于儿童疫苗接种追踪和转介的数字平台，由尼日利亚卡诺州44个地方政府区域（LGA）中两个LGA的56名女性社区动员员使用。我们开展了一项项目案例研究，涵盖：1）2024年8月至2025年4月（初始实施阶段）；以及2）适应性实施阶段（2025年5月至2025年11月），在此期间引入LxD以应对新出现的挑战。LxD包括结构化跟随观察、每月用户访谈、行动后回顾以及变更日志，以在常规服务的同时追踪适应性调整。绩效通过四项指标进行监测：已处理的反馈、对用户反馈的响应时间、易用性评分以及动员员在追踪ZD儿童方面的表现。发现：在引入LxD后，共识别出17个问题，并促成了12项优先适应性调整。所有记录的问题均获得了回应，中位响应时间降至约两周，同时社区动员员报告数字平台的可用性有所提高（例如，平均易用性评分为4.1分，满分5分）。增强的根本原因分析使趋势追踪成为可能，并为免疫接种点微缺货等系统性问题提供了更清晰的升级路径。共情工具记录揭示了动员员在使用平台时遇到的困难。这些问题被立即记录，促使用户体验重新设计为从登记到转介的无缝单步流程。在LxD实施期间，通过MCH-Track平均每月识别出33名ZD儿童，较LxD实施前（平均每月识别11名ZD儿童）大幅增加。平均转介到接种率在LxD期间也有所改善，从LxD实施前已识别并转介的ZD儿童中获得免疫接种服务的44%上升至引入LxD实践后的70%。结论：将LxD嵌入MCH-Track加强了共同创造，简化了工作流程，并提升了社区动员员的表现，展示了适应性管理在覆盖ZD儿童方面的价值。
